thread:
Hana: Quick catch during the migration guide pass: we're mixing `kebab-case` and `snake_case` for config keys in examples. Seen `cache-size` and `cache_size` side-by-side. Can we pick one?
Diego: Kebab (param-case) is the canonical choice for docs code/config. Matches the glossary decision.
Marta: Agreed. I'll do a small sweep of the caching docs and examples. Found one in /docs/guides/cache.md already.
Hana: Thanks. Also, can we clarify in the style guide that prose should say 'cache size' but inline code/config use `cache-size`? Small note will help new contributors.
Vik: I'll add that line to /docs/style.md and append a tiny example. Also adding a checkbox to PR template: "Parameter names follow docs param-case."
DocsBot: heads-up: snippet-test flagged 1 example using `cache_size` in /docs/guides/cache.md.
Diego: Marta, can you push the patch to that page and then ping for review? I'll do a quick grep afterwards for other occurrences.
Marta: On it. I'll create PR and replace `cache_size` -> `cache-size` in code blocks, leave prose as 'cache size'.
Hana: Nice. After merge can someone trigger the docs-snippet-test job?
Vik: I'll queue a post-merge run.
DocsBot: job queued: docs-snippet-test (post-merge).
